reviews.text: Zahirah is a breathe of fresh air. She is beautiful inside and out. My make up was flawless and she made me feel pretty! I will always use her for my special events.
reviews.author: Gretchen Vaughn

reviews.text: Zahirah was very friendly and professional. I enjoyed my makeover and I like the care Zahirah put in applying my makeup while teaching me about the different products.
reviews.author: Thelma Searcy

reviews.text: Zahirah, Was a great professional she was on time her work is flawless. I really had a great time and she is forever my permanent makeup artist.
reviews.author: Asia Santana

reviews.text: Zariyah  did amazing job on my daughter makeup for graduation , I totally recommend her to anybody who wants a soft  glam  makeup. Very friendly and very professional. Thank you beautiful
reviews.author: Careese Ausberry

reviews.text: My experience here was amazing. The boutique was so clean and Zahirah made me feel so comfortable. I was super happy with the results and received so many compliments. Thank you for making me look fabulous and definitely suggest everyone come to Zahirah for all your beauty needs.
reviews.author: Desiree Brown
